title: The lost property office
about: A railway station's lost property office. Its queries say what's there, its commands hand things in and claim them, and two workers act when nobody is waiting: one when something is handed in, and one on a schedule.
storySoFar: Six things are waiting to be claimed, from a left glove to a set of false teeth (upper only). The roller skate and the library book have waited three months, so the next charity collection takes them.
Yesterday the traveller reported losing a black umbrella with a duck's head handle. Nobody has handed one in.
tryThis: As the clerk, hand in an umbrella found at any station.
As the traveller, look at your lost reports: the office has noticed it may be yours, and offers a link to claim it. Claim it, then try claiming it again.
As the traveller, try claiming the tuba with your umbrella report.
The charity collects early each morning: see what was donated to charity.
